title: family_get_activity
description: Read the activity of the children in scope (read view of the log), newest first. client_id narrows to one child device, kinds to some kinds; since at most data/family.json settings activity_days back. Paging with cursor. Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_activity.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.
